exceptions_and_evidence_limits: The required prior separating planet or first lord in Sun's house is explicit; these are unconfirmed alternatives, not reliable causes.

rules.source_statement: The ascendant lord separating from VENUS, OR situated in the house of Venus, is associated by Lilly with drink, cards, dice, music, tavern or time with women as possible original circumstances of the loss.
preconditions: Source condition is explicit only insofar as in source_statement; verify historical glyphs and conjunction logic against original image.
exceptions_and_evidence_limits: The required prior separating planet or first lord in Venus's house is explicit; these are unconfirmed alternatives, not reliable causes.

rules.source_statement: Separating from Mercury is associated with writing, delivering or dictating letters, or sending a message.

rules.source_statement: Separating from Moon or being in Moon's house is attributed to frequent/common use, a messenger, widow or servant.

rules.source_statement: If Moon's house lord separates from some other planet, the beast is said to have fled on its own.

rules.source_statement: Only AFTER checking both the Moon's house lord AND the second-house lord for the specified separating relation, if neither shows separation, Lilly says the beast still remains where it was.

rules.source_statement: If Moon's domicile lord exhibits no relevant separation, ALSO inspect the second-house lord in the SAME manner; the latter is the next prescribed check BEFORE calling the beast still in place.

exceptions_and_evidence_limits: Source fallback order: lunar domicile lord -> second-house lord -> combined nonseparation inference. R2161 states the final conclusion.

rules.source_statement: If the Moon applies to the LORD OF THE EIGHTH HOUSE COUNTED FROM THE MOON, Lilly says the missing beast is dead.
preconditions: Source condition is explicit only insofar as in source_statement; verify historical glyphs and conjunction logic against original image.
exceptions_and_evidence_limits: The eighth FROM Moon is not the radical eighth house; animal death is unverified historic assertion.

rules.source_statement: If the Moon's domicile ruler applies to the LORD OF THE EIGHTH FROM THE MOON, the beast is said to be dead OR TO DIE VERY SHORTLY.
preconditions: Source condition is explicit only insofar as in source_statement; verify historical glyphs and conjunction logic against original image.
exceptions_and_evidence_limits: Retain from-Moon derived house and the printed soon-to-die alternative, not near-death or source-independent medical evidence.

rules.source_statement: When Moon and her house lord do not make the preceding contacts with the eighth FROM Moon, Lilly instructs a LAST resort using the LORD OF THE RADICAL EIGHTH HOUSE.
preconditions: Source condition is explicit only insofar as in source_statement; verify historical glyphs and conjunction logic against original image.
exceptions_and_evidence_limits: A genuine different fallback significator; do not replace both prior Moon-derived eighth lords with radical eighth.

rules.source_statement: Thief significator in ascendant, or transmitting virtue to Moon, or Moon transmitting virtue to it, is associated with a stolen missing thing.
preconditions: Source condition is explicit only insofar as in source_statement; verify historical glyphs and conjunction logic against original image.
exceptions_and_evidence_limits: Role direction and original signifiers must be preserved.

rules.source_statement: An application from ASCENDANT LORD to the alleged thief significator is one source theft claim; ALTERNATIVELY, the thief significator APPLYING to ascendant lord BY SQUARE OR OPPOSITION is another.

rules.source_statement: The source lists Moon and lords of her house, term and second, and the Part-of-Fortune-like body, in possible contacts WITH THE ALLEGED THIEF SIGNIFICATOR; it does not say Moon directly aspects every listed lord.

preconditions: Source condition is explicit only insofar as in source_statement; verify historical glyphs and conjunction logic against original image.
exceptions_and_evidence_limits: Author's negative conclusion has exceptions and can still mean LOSING (not independently proven theft); preserve Part-of-Fortune lord.

rules.source_statement: For strayed beasts/fugitives/lost property, Moon applying to first or second lord or own dispositor is offered for recovery.
preconditions: Source condition is explicit only insofar as in source_statement; verify historical glyphs and conjunction logic against original image.
exceptions_and_evidence_limits: This is a new general heading and combines three topic types.

rules.source_statement: Moon in ascendant or Moon's dispositor in trine/sextile provides hope of recovery.
preconditions: Source condition is explicit only insofar as in source_statement; verify historical glyphs and conjunction logic against original image.

rules.source_statement: Moon's domicile ruler separating from sixth/eighth/twelfth lord and then applying to the FIRST HOUSE LORD OR THE DEGREE/CUSP OF SECOND is an alleged favourable sign.

rules.source_statement: If the Moon is afflicted by rulers of sixth/eighth/twelfth, particularly when an infortune beholds her under the named configuration, Lilly suspects goods retained by a harmful person.

exceptions_and_evidence_limits: The especially-if infortune aspect qualifies intensity; allegations of dishonesty have no real evidentiary basis.

rules.source_statement: Another planet separating from Moon's house lord suggests theft; Moon's house lord separating from another indicates wandering.

rules.source_statement: MOON in ascendant, OR Moon in TRINE to the lord of ascendant, OR Moon in TRINE to the SUN, is offered as a favourable recovery reading.

rules.source_statement: Movable signs are read as HIGH places, ceilings or roofs; watery signs as IN WATER OR UNDER THE EARTH, pavement or foundations.

rules.source_statement: Moon applying to LORD OF EIGHTH OR TO EIGHTH HOUSE, or Moon-house lord applying to eighth, is said to imply beast death. Another branch puts beast's significator IN EIGHTH AND SQUARE TO AN INFORTUNE IN FOURTH.
preconditions: Source condition is explicit only insofar as in source_statement; verify historical glyphs and conjunction logic against original image.
exceptions_and_evidence_limits: Moon application to eighth HOUSE is an independent alternative. 'In fourth' modifies the ill planet. Apparent geometry tension is source uncertainty, not to be repaired.

rules.source_statement: Sixth/twelfth lord in ninth or tenth supposedly puts strayed cattle with a JUSTICE OR OFFICER, under LOCK or ordered to be kept safe.

exceptions_and_evidence_limits: Retain custody alternatives; not real detention evidence.

rules.source_statement: FOR THE MOST PART, the lord of TWELFTH OR SIXTH IN TWELFTH OR SIXTH indicates cattle KEPT CLOSE in an enclosure.

exceptions_and_evidence_limits: FIFTH, not sixth; source uses ambiguous 'they be found' for the beneficiary/animal placement. Conditional conjunction and authorial scope retained.

rules.source_statement: Lunar term lord or fourth-cusp ruler joined to first ruler provides another favourable cattle-recovery indication.

rules.source_statement: Sixth lord in fiery sign suggests eastward woods/burnt brush; angular fiery adds enclosures.

rules.source_statement: Sixth lord in airy sign is associated with open flat land to west; angular enclosed or succedent right/west.

rules.source_statement: Sixth lord in watery sign suggests northern low ground, water meadows or place where cattle watered.
